5 Qur'an passages on patience for the days that feel heavy.

Swipe through slowly. Allah reminds us that He is with the patient, that hardship comes with ease, and that nothing reaches us except what He has decreed.

— Surah Al-Baqara 2:153
— Surah Al-Baqara 2:155-157
— Surah Ash-Sharh 94:5-6
— Surah At-Tawba 9:51
— Surah Az-Zumar 39:10
